scope.domain: 2025 Russian 3-NDFL declaration semantics for securities-disposal income.
scope.taxpayer_profile: Russian tax resident declaring securities and derivatives operations outside an individual investment account.
scope.operation_profile: Organized-market securities operations classified by Appendix 8 operation code 01 and Section 2 income group 02, income type 003.
scope.boundary: Covers complete-category Appendix 8 semantics and the corresponding group-bound Section 2 lines 001-060. It does not claim generation, assembly, validation or filing of a complete electronic declaration or calculation of tax payable.

requirements.official_requirement: For the complete operation-code-01 securities category, produce the operation kind, aggregate income, related expenses, expenses reducing income and loss-treatment indicator required by Appendix 8 lines 010-050.

Project the five complete-category securities semantics into a declaration-shaped Appendix 8 occurrence corresponding to electronic element ДохОперЦБ and attributes ВидОпер, ДохСовОпер, РасхРеалЦБ, РасхУмДохОпер and ПризУчетУбыт.

Produce the complete income-group calculation semantics needed for Section 2: income totals, non-taxable income, taxable income, deductions, accepted securities expenses and the resulting tax base, with Appendix 8 accepted expenses contributing to the calculation.
Project one separate Section 2 income-group fragment for resident non-IIS securities and derivatives operations using income group 02 and income type 003, including lines 001-060.

Produce a complete electronic-format 5.20 declaration contract in which the securities ДохОперЦБ occurrence and the corresponding group-bound Section 2 НалБаза/РасчНалБаза structure are assembled under the required 2025 3-NDFL document hierarchy.

gaps.required_semantic: Deterministic assembly and validation of the supported Appendix 8 and Section 2 fragments within the complete electronic-format 5.20 3-NDFL document hierarchy required by the supplied XSD.
gaps.explanation: The supplied projection capability emits only bounded partial declaration fragments and expressly makes no full-XML claim. No supplied runtime capability assembles those fragments into the complete document hierarchy or validates a complete document against the target XSD.
